text: D233997 proposed for...of for the original LiveViewRowMap. The author rejected that change because the array can contain many unfilled slots, and the actual landing retains forEach in add/remove handlers with a comment explaining defined-index iteration and the lack of early exit. This is a scoped historical exception to the normal for...of preference for action loops. It does not reverse the user-directed guidance, establish a performance benchmark or justify mechanical replacements. The fixed async adapter has retired LiveViewRowMap, so preserve the reasoning as historical context rather than copying the old caching architecture. The existing sparse-architecture lesson remains separate. No loop timing or Thunderbird test ran.
title: Keep the sparse-row forEach exception separate from the loop preference
